apps/web/components/organisms/DesktopTit.loading: The titlebar fetches nothing; the placeholder skeleton shown before the sidebar context mounts only renders inside the Electron runtime, which Storybook cannot enter (useIsElectronRuntime is false there). DesktopTitlebar.interaction.test.tsx covers the provider-less path.
apps/web/components/organisms/DesktopTit.empty: The titlebar owns no collection; it renders two history buttons and a drag strip. The detector matched the items-center class.
apps/web/components/organisms/DesktopTit.long-content: The titlebar renders only icon buttons and fixed-width regions; the release identity label truncates with max-w-64 and is covered by the unverified-build test.
apps/web/components/organisms/DesktopTit.offline: The titlebar makes no request; its state comes from the Electron bridge and the sidebar context, which behave identically offline.
apps/web/components/organisms/DesktopTit.permission-denied: No role or gated branch; the controls show whenever the Electron runtime is present.
apps/web/components/organisms/DesktopTit.rtl-overflow: The row is a flex strip pinned to the window titlebar by the Electron shell; the traffic-light safe area is physically left on macOS regardless of document direction.

apps/web/components/organisms/HowItWorks.rtl-overflow: The section is a centered grid of text cards with no physical offsets except the decorative top border gradient, which is aria-hidden chrome.

apps/web/components/organisms/OperatorLi.error: The list query's failure resolves to no data, which renders the same New List-only block as the Empty story; the create failure is a toast owned by the feedback layer and asserted in OperatorListsNav.test.tsx.
apps/web/components/organisms/OperatorLi.offline: The nav makes no request of its own; the query hook owns connectivity and an offline read renders the same block as LoadingNoData.
apps/web/components/organisms/OperatorLi.rtl-overflow: Rows use the shared sidebar row classes with min-w-0 truncation; direction handling belongs to the shell sidebar.

apps/web/components/organisms/Persistent.loading: Playback state comes from useTrackAudioPlayer, which a story cannot drive without a real audio element; the loading branch only swaps the play label and disables the seek bar. PersistentAudioBar.test.tsx and the shell tests cover the dock.
apps/web/components/organisms/Persistent.empty: With no active track the component renders an empty dock by design (zero reserved space); the empty case is asserted in PersistentAudioBar.test.tsx and the dock itself owns the 0-height state.
apps/web/components/organisms/Persistent.error: A preview failure raises a toast through onError from useTrackAudioPlayer; the bar draws no inline error UI, and the toast is owned by the feedback layer.
apps/web/components/organisms/Persistent.long-content: Titles use TruncatedText with one-line clamps inside min-w-0 columns; truncation is owned by TruncatedText.
apps/web/components/organisms/Persistent.offline: The bar never fetches; playback state and errors come from the audio hook, and an unavailable preview shows the same toast as the error case.
apps/web/components/organisms/Persistent.permission-denied: The bar has no role or gated branch; any signed-in user with an active track sees it. The detector matched the role semantics on the Audio Player landmark.
apps/web/components/organisms/Persistent.rtl-overflow: The dock is a flex row of fixed-width controls and truncating text with no physical offsets except the visibility toggle's centered hit area.

apps/web/components/organisms/ProfileSwi.loading: The switching spinner shows only for the instant between choosing an identity and the response, after a pointer interaction a static story cannot script; ProfileSwitcher.test.tsx covers the switch.
apps/web/components/organisms/ProfileSwi.error: A failed switch is a toast through the feedback layer with the server's message and no inline UI; ProfileSwitcher.test.tsx asserts the toast and that the route does not refresh.
apps/web/components/organisms/ProfileSwi.offline: The switcher fetches only on an explicit selection and reports a network failure through the same toast as the error case.
apps/web/components/organisms/ProfileSwi.permission-denied: The switcher lists the user's own identities and has no role or gated branch; with fewer than two it renders nothing (EmptySingleIdentity).
apps/web/components/organisms/ProfileSwi.rtl-overflow: The trigger and rows are flex with min-w-0 truncation; the menu is a Radix dropdown that mirrors under dir=rtl, and text-left on the name follows the sidebar's direction.

apps/web/components/organisms/desktop-up.offline: The view takes only the update phase and notes as props; a failed release-notes fetch resolves to the same changelog-link fallback shown in the base AvailableFallbackLink story, and the error phase is already a story.
apps/web/components/organisms/desktop-up.rtl-overflow: The dialog is a portal-rendered Radix dialog whose layout uses flex gap and min-w-0 with no directional offsets; the surrounding Dialog owns direction handling.

apps/web/components/organisms/entity-car.permission-denied: The card is presentational over a model; it has no role or gated branch (a disabled CTA is the sold-out state, shown in UnavailableShow). The detector matched the person entity kind.
apps/web/components/organisms/entity-car.rtl-overflow: The card lays out with flex and truncation on a model's text and takes no directional offsets; the surrounding grid owns direction.

apps/web/components/organisms/entity-car.permission-denied: The carousel lays out cards from props and has no role or gated branch. The detector matched the role semantics on its list items.
apps/web/components/organisms/entity-car.rtl-overflow: Scrolling uses the browser's snap track, which mirrors under dir=rtl natively; the carousel sets no physical offsets of its own beyond scrollTo by index.

apps/web/components/organisms/footer-mod.rtl-overflow: The footer is a flex and grid layout with wrapping link rows and no physical offsets except the profile legal links pinned to the viewport corner by design; direction is owned by the page.

apps/web/components/organisms/home-loop/.offline: The list takes asks and answers as props and makes no request; a failed send resolves to the failed answer state shown in ErrorAnswerFailed.
apps/web/components/organisms/home-loop/.permission-denied: Asks arrive already filtered by the server; the component has no role or gated branch. The detector matched the decidable flag, which only enables the action.
apps/web/components/organisms/home-loop/.rtl-overflow: Cards are flex columns with line-clamp and min-w-0 and no physical offsets; direction is owned by the page.

apps/web/components/organisms/home-loop/.permission-denied: The canvas renders the company loop for the operator route, which the server layout gates before it renders; it takes no role or permission input. The detector matched the role or status wiring on its regions.

apps/web/components/organisms/opportunit.permission-denied: The row is a presentational list item driven by state and callbacks; it has no role or gated branch. The detector matched the accepted and rejected row states.
apps/web/components/organisms/opportunit.rtl-overflow: Title and metadata truncate inside a flex row with min-w-0 and the actions are shrink-0; the row sets no physical offsets, and the swipe handlers read raw clientX by design.

apps/web/components/organisms/release-si.rtl-overflow: Rows are flex with min-w-0 and the shared drawer link rows, with no physical offsets; direction is owned by the drawer.
